repairs: Supported native and adapter unary PD calls now consume shared network-based forwarding selection and immutable per-attempt logical-leader metadata. Region-local cooldown and rotation do not suppress forwarding. Canonical startup enable-forwarding reaches both clients through one options owner; healthy leader recovery restores direct traffic. Membership/health probes and keyspace management remain direct, as Go requires. Region API fallback retains follower-local context when allowed; its error retry uses leader forwarding. Three duplicate adapter store/GC failover loops are retired into the existing shared loop, preserving old-server GC fallback and terminal errors. Forwarding-enabled ordinary calls make one selected RPC; errors cannot fall into an untagged direct-member retry. TSO forwarding/follower-proxy streams, router transport and complete package/platform obligations remain open.

before.support_scaffolding: Options constructors and existing mock metadata capture staged before routing; same two transport regressions fail independently in both repos. Additional shutdown/caller coverage follows integration.
before.diagnostic_limits: Initial lint invocation lacked the Cloud environment activation; corrected make lint passed. A pre-push runner was canceled before Git push to finish keyspace and region-fallback source review. Fresh native gates passed after correction.
